出生地: 英国,英格兰,苏塞克斯,奇切斯特
简介:
Jim Howick was born on May 14, 1979 in Chichester, Sussex, England. He is an actor and writer, known for Hellboy (2004), Horrible Histories (2009) and The Armstrong and Miller Show (2007).
